The area

Location & Access

Lockheed Drive at Montana Ave (Hwy 62) — El Paso International Airport across the street

The building fronts Montana Ave (±35,690 ADT), directly across the street from the El Paso International Airport property and just minutes from the passenger terminal, with quick access to I-10 and Loop 375 for teams commuting across the city.
